Country.evidence_source: This is the first study to examine the psychometric properties of BSRS scores in non-British women. Our results suggest that BSRS-derived scores have adequate convergent validity in Brazilian university women, insofar as ratings of current breast size were significantly correlated with actual bra size. First, the study was conducted with university women from a single region in Brazil.

section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the psychometric properties of the BSRS (Breast Size Rating Scale) in Brazilian university women, confirming its convergent validity with measures like bra size and BMI, and its test-retest reliability. It highlights a high prevalence of breast size dissatisfaction in the sample, with most women desiring larger breasts, a finding compared to Swami et al. (2015), Studies 2 and 3. Limitations regarding generalizability and scope are acknowledged for the present study.
